verses.sanskrit:
सञ्जय उवाच।
              ततः पुनर्महाराज मद्रराजमरिन्दमः । अभ्यभाषत राधेयः सन्निवार्योत्तरं वचः ॥१॥
verses.english: Sanjaya said Once more, O great king, thus silencing the king of Madras, the son of Radha, the chastiser of foes, said to him.

verses.sanskrit: यत्त्वं निदर्शनार्थं मां शल्य जल्पितवानसि । नाहं शक्यस्त्वया वाचा बिभीषयितुमाहवे ॥२॥
verses.english: As a rejoinder to what you have said to me, O Shalya, by way of examples I tell you that I am not to be frightened by you in battle with your words.
verses.bhavadeepa: तत इति । ततः अनन्तरं शल्येन वक्तव्यं वचः सन्निवार्य स्वयमेवाहेत्यर्थः ॥१॥

verses.sanskrit: यदि मां देवताः सर्वा योधयेयुः सवासवाः । तथापि मे भयं न स्यात्किमु पार्थात्सकेशवात् ॥३॥
verses.english: If all the gods with Vasava come to fight with me I will not fear them what to speak of my fear from Partha and Kesava.

verses.sanskrit: नाहं भीषयितुं शक्यो वाङ्मात्रेण कथञ्चन । अन्यं जानीहि यः शक्यस्त्वया भीषयितुं रणे ॥४॥
verses.english: I am not to be frightened by mere words. O Shalya, he, whom you will be able to frighten in battle, is some other person.

verses.sanskrit: नीचस्य बलमेतावत्पारुष्यं यत्त्वमात्थ माम् । अशक्तो मद्गुणान् वक्तुं वल्गसे बहु दुर्मते ॥५॥
verses.english: You have addressed many unpleasant words to me. Therein lies the strength of a mean person, O you of wicked soul; you can speak of my merits and so you say many unpleasant words.

verses.sanskrit: न हि कर्णः समुद्भूतो भयार्थमिह मद्रक । विक्रमार्थमहं जातो यशोर्थं च तथाऽऽत्मनः ॥६॥
verses.english: Karna is not born for fear in battle, O Madraka. I am rather born to display my valour and achieve glory for my own self.

verses.sanskrit: सखिभावेन सौहार्दान्मित्रभावेन चैव हि। कारणैस्त्रिभिरेतैस्त्वं शल्य जीवसि सांप्रतम् ॥७॥
verses.english: Out of friendship for you, out of my affection and on account of your being an ally-for these three reasons, you still live, O Shalya.

verses.sanskrit: राज्ञश्च धार्तराष्ट्रस्य कार्यं सुमहदुद्यतम् । मयि तच्चाहितं शल्य तेन जीवसि मे क्षणम् ॥८॥
verses.english: A great work is now to be done for the king Dhritarashtra. This work depends on me, O Shalya and therefore you live for a moment,
verses.bhavadeepa: सखिभावः सारथ्येनोपकारकत्वं सौहार्दं मदीया क्षमा मित्रस्य दुर्योधनस्य भावः इष्टसिद्धिः हेतुरित्यर्थः ॥७॥

verses.sanskrit: कुतश्च समयः पूर्वं क्षन्तव्यं विप्रियं तव । ऋते शल्यसहस्त्रेण विजयेयमहं परान् । मित्रद्रोहस्तु पापीयानिति जीवसि सांप्रतम् ॥९॥
verses.english: I made this agreement with you formerly that I would forgive you for all your unpleasant words. This agreement I will observe and for this you still live. Without a thousand Shalyas I will vanquish my enemies. The injurer of a friend is sinful. It is for this you live for the present.
